confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and the supplied city, country, and July 2026 window; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies widely by neighborhood and season, and July often brings domestic school-holiday demand. Cocktail and wine_glass are set at roughly two times the beer anchor because direct price recall for them is weaker. The inexpensive meal anchor assumes a main meal without alcohol.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Anchors are calibrated to general Brazilian major-metro restaurant and hotel price levels, with a Zona Sul (Copacabana and Ipanema) beachfront tourism premium applied to accommodation.
